signals.title: إيران: SANAD tension score crossed 60
signals.summary: The deterministic SANAD tension output crossed its documented export threshold.
observed_facts: Published tension score: 60; published level: متوتّر.
signals.assessment: The deterministic SANAD tension output crossed its documented export threshold.
signals.inference: This is a threshold notification, not a prediction of violence or a government warning.
signals.uncertainty: The score reflects the inputs and weights published by SANAD and can change as source coverage changes.
